items.title: Costco Motor Oil Prices Nearly Double As Iran War Squeezes Supply - Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ:COST)
items.summary: Costco has significantly increased prices for its private-label motor oil and implemented purchase limits due to rising crude oil costs linked to the ongoing Iran war. Kirkland Signature full-synthetic motor oil's price nearly doubled to $57.99 for a two-pack, and both Kirkland and Mobil 1 products now have membership-based purchase restrictions. This reflects broader market impacts, with national average gas and diesel prices also setting records, leading to political commentary on energy costs.

items.title: Coca-Cola report shows $85B U.S. economic impact across foodservice, retail and more
items.summary: A new independent study commissioned by The Coca-Cola Company reveals its system contributes $85 billion to the U.S. GDP and supports nearly 1 million jobs annually. The company also plans to invest $10 billion in U.S. infrastructure from 2026 through 2030, underscoring its significant economic impact and commitment to local communities across America.

items.title: Howmet Aerospace announces expansion to Wichita Falls facility
items.summary: Howmet Aerospace is investing approximately $70 million to expand its Wichita Falls manufacturing facility by 100,000 square feet. This expansion will create 230 new full-time jobs with an average annual salary of $72,000 and retain nearly 900 current employees. The project aims to strengthen the facility's role in the global aerospace supply chain and reinforce Wichita Falls as a significant center for aerospace and advanced manufacturing.

items.title: Jim Cramer Says Lululemon (LULU) is in “No Man’s Land” After Another Brutal Quarter
items.summary: Jim Cramer describes Lululemon (LULU) as being in "no man's land" following a challenging quarter, citing deteriorating demand, increased competition, and execution issues. The company reported a revenue decline and cut its full-year forecast, despite an earnings beat largely due to tariff refunds. Cramer advises against buying the stock, emphasizing that its lower valuation isn't enough to justify an investment given ongoing competitive pressures and a need for improved demand and execution.

items.title: Site Selection magazine names PPL Electric Utilities a top utility for economic development, citing $12.8 billion in supported investment across Pennsylvania in 2025
items.summary: Site Selection magazine recognized PPL Electric Utilities as a top utility for economic development, acknowledging its role in supporting $12.8 billion in capital investment and creating 1,775 new jobs across Pennsylvania in 2025. This achievement, based on corporate facility investment and job creation, highlights the utility's reliable infrastructure and collaborative efforts with regional partners. It's also the first time PPL's Pennsylvania and Kentucky operations received this distinction simultaneously.

items.title: RBC Capital lowers McDonald’s stock price target on estimate cuts By Investing.com
items.summary: RBC Capital has reduced its price target for McDonald's (NYSE:MCD) to $290 from $295, maintaining a Sector Perform rating, as the stock trades near its 52-week low. The firm's estimates were lowered ahead of McDonald's investor day, where the company is expected to detail its NEXT strategy and new financial targets through 2030, including a remodel program. RBC Capital anticipates that investor interest in restaurant stocks will not increase until same-store sales growth reaccelerates, likely not before Q1 2027.

items.title: FedEx Expands Sustainable Aviation Fuel Agreements Across U.S. Air Network
items.summary: FedEx has expanded its sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) procurement through new agreements set to secure over 20 million gallons of neat SAF across five U.S. airports by 2027. These agreements will result in SAF blend ratios of 30% to 50% and are a significant step towards FedEx's goal of sourcing 30% of jet fuel from alternative sources by 2030, supporting its broader aim for carbon-neutral global operations by 2040. The company emphasizes SAF's role in decarbonization and its commitment to stimulating market growth for reliable and affordable SAF.

items.title: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) Stock Price Drops On Capital Spending Fears While Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ: PANW) And ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) Surge
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) shares dropped 3.7% due to capital spending concerns and Larry Ellison's cancellation of a $7.5 billion stock-sale program. In contrast, ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) surged 7.4% as investors reconsidered AI's threat to enterprise software, and Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ: PANW) gained 13.1% amidst rising demand for cybersecurity solutions against AI-enabled threats. Meanwhile, Bank of America (NYSE: BAC) fell 5.1% after its CEO predicted a significant decline in investment-banking fees.
